mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bargain_campaign (product_id, buyer_id, start_price, current_price, floor_price, status, deadline) VALUES (#{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{startPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{floorPrice}, #{status}, #{deadline})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bargain_campaign WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bargain_campaign SET current_price = #{currentPrice} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bargain_campaign SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deadline < #{now}
UPDATE bargain_campaign SET status = 'CONVERTED' WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
